text: In this place, I sense a tension between utility and creativity. The sterile, ordered meeting space with glass walls feels detached, almost cold—an environment built for clarity, yet devoid of warmth. Stepping into the vivid, informative corridor, I am greeted by energetic displays that celebrate innovation and inquiry. This juxtaposition makes me curious about the relationship between the spaces where ideas are born and those where they are displayed. Am I merely passing through, or am I part of this ongoing dialogue between thought and expression?
